answer: Witnessed Summit Attestation requires each identity to be confirmed by three geographically dispersed hardware devices that co-sign a time-bound location proof at a physical summit event. A single operator cannot fake this because the devices are independently owned and their signatures bind to distinct radio-range observations. Each fake identity costs a separate attended event, travel, and device coordination—a real voyage per registration. Detection ripples across the attestation graph, revoking clustered fakes.
